oral_examination.oral_examination: 47 There is a deep and large carious cavity in the distal adjacent maxillofacial surface. When probing and percussing, the teeth are not loose and the gums are red and swollen. CBCT showed deep caries penetrating the pulp and no obvious abnormality in the root tip. 17. Black discoloration was seen on the tooth surface, roughness and hardness were detected during probing, and the probe was stuck and percussed. The teeth were not loose, and the gums were not red or swollen. 18

diagnosis.primary: 47 Acute pulpitis (K04.001) 17 Dental caries (K02.900) 18 48 Impacted tooth (K01.100)

treatment_plan.definitive: 47 Root canal treatment and crown restoration. Filler treatment. 18 48 removal.
treatment_plan.notes: Instruct patients to avoid eating foods that are too cold/hot/hard/sticky. If you have looseness and discomfort, you should follow up in time and make an appointment by phone before coming.
